acquisition_scope: Implemented opt-in encounter roots plus transitive supported emitted evolution edges, not native gameplay proof. All matching staged dependencies must be integrated together.
battle_support_requires: matching generated species, dex and graphics headers
support_scope: battle_supported and supported_slots describe emitted native-normal slots [0,1] only, not hidden abilities, acquisition or full donor feature parity; legacy rows are not reimported
ability_policy: CreateBoxMon uses personality & 1 only when normal slot 1 is nonzero, otherwise slot 0. Hidden slot 2 is metadata only and never substituted. No saved ABI changes.

support_limits.level_up: complete resolved donor level-up learnset with no move substitution
support_limits.teachable: native TM/HM and tutor subset only; unavailable_teachable_moves lists omissions
support_limits.hidden_abilities: unsupported for every emitted species, including hidden abilities with existing battle effect symbols
support_limits.acquisition: seven explicit opt-in Route 101/102/103 roots including Route 103 fishing Magikarp/Arrokuda plus closure over supported emitted native evolution edges only; other emitted species including Kubfu have no implemented acquisition path; support is not gameplay proof
support_limits.runtime: staged output only; all matching generated files and headers must be promoted together before runtime selection changes
support_limits.rendering: static first front frame only; donor cries and followers are not integrated
support_limits.evolution: only exact unconditional EVO_LEVEL triples with levels 1..100 and native/base or selected targets are emitted; supported_evolutions and unsupported_evolutions record every descriptor; legacy rows are untouched
support_limits.donor_features: egg moves, form changes and expanded Dex persistence are not implied by battle_supported

level_up_profile: highest available donor generation per learnset (Gen 9 preferred)
policy: No unsupported move, ability or evolution edge is substituted. Reserved species are not playable. Only supported_evolutions are integrated; other evolution descriptors, form changing, cry audio and expanded Dex persistence remain explicit limitations.
